# Saraswati Sweets - Full Reference
> Pure Desi Ghee Mithai & Artisanal Namkeen Since 1978. Heritage sweet shop based in Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh, crafting authentic Indian sweets, traditional savories, and premium festive gift hampers.

## Store Background & Quality Guarantee
Saraswati Sweets has been a cornerstone of traditional confectionery in Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh since 1978. Every sweet is prepared using 100% pure desi cow ghee, grade-A dry fruits, and slow-simmered rich khoya without artificial preservatives or starch adulteration.

- Physical Store Address: Saraswati Sweets, Indira Market, Begum Gunj, Barabanki, Uttar Pradesh 225001
- Official Website: https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/
- Contact Phone / WhatsApp: +91 91611 10030
- Contact Email: order@saraswatisweets.in

## Public Web Navigation
- [Home Page](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/): Online storefront featuring daily freshly prepared sweets, special offers, and festive collections.
- [Sweet Catalog](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/catalog): Complete catalog of sweets, laddoos, pedas, barfis, and namkeen.
- [Product Categories](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories): Categorized navigation by sweet and savory types.
- [Festive Gift Hampers](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/hampers): Curated celebration gift boxes with customized silk and velvet packaging.
- [Bulk & Corporate Orders](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/bulk-enquiry): Order bulk quantities for weddings, receptions, and corporate gifting.
- [Contact & Store Information](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/contact): Store location, operational hours, customer care, and WhatsApp enquiry.

## Categories & Specialty Offerings
- [Peda](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories/peda): Heritage Awadhi pedas, notably Barabanki Kesar Peda and Khoya Peda.
- [Laddu](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories/laddu): Pure shuddh desi ghee Motichoor Laddu, Besan Laddu, and seasonal Pinni / Gond Laddu.
- [Barfi](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories/barfi): Signature Silver Leaf Kaju Katli, Milk Cake, and traditional Khoya Barfi.
- [Khoya Sweets](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories/khoya-sweets): Melt-in-mouth Gulab Jamun, Kala Jamun, Rasgulla, and Malai Peda.
- [Dry Fruit Sweets](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories/dry-fruit-sweets): Cashew rolls, pistachio fudge, and anjeer dry fruit sweets.
- [Namkeen & Savories](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/categories/namkeen): Awadhi Shahi Dalmoth Mixture, Khasta Ajwain Mathri, Mini Samosa, and crispy Bhujia.

## Featured Products
- [Signature Silver Leaf Kaju Katli](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/kaju-katli): Diamond-cut cashew fudge made with premium cashews, pure ghee, and edible silver leaf. Available in 250g, 500g, and 1kg boxes.
- [Pure Shuddh Ghee Motichoor Ladoo](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/motichoor-ladoo): Golden gram flour pearl ladoos infused with Kashmiri saffron and pure cow ghee. Available in 250g, 500g, and 1kg packs.
- [Barabanki Kesar Peda](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/kesar-peda): Iconic Barabanki specialty slow-simmered milk fudge garnished with saffron and pistachios. Available in 250g and 500g boxes.
- [Besan Laddu](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/besan-laddu): Slow-roasted gram flour spheres enriched with pure desi ghee and crunchy dry fruits.
- [Gulab Jamun](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/gulab-jamun): Soft khoya dumplings soaked in warm rosewater and green cardamom syrup.
- [Spongy Rasgulla](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/rasgulla): Light, spongy fresh chenna dumplings steeped in aromatic sugar syrup.
- [Awadhi Shahi Dalmoth Mixture](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/dalmoth): Spicy, crunchy royal savory mixture with fried lentils, cashews, and traditional Awadhi spices.
- [Crispy Ajwain Khasta Mathri](https://saraswatisweetsbarabanki.com/products/mathri): Flaky, golden fried savory crackers flavored with carom seeds (ajwain).
